title: AdTech Market: Trends, Innovations, and Growth Outlook 2032
summary: The global AdTech market, valued at USD 953.91 billion in 2023, is projected to reach USD 3,421.29 billion by 2032, growing at a CAGR of 15.25%. This growth is driven by the shift to digital advertising, demand for personalized experiences, and key segments like on-premise deployment and large enterprises dominating the market. North America is currently the largest market shareholder, while Asia-Pacific is expected to be the fastest-growing region.

title: S&P 500 rises 5.7% in November to log best month of 2024
summary: The S&P 500 experienced its best month of 2024 in November, rising 5.7% following a post-election stock bump. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and Russell 2000 also saw significant gains, 7.5% and 10.8% respectively. Consumer discretionary led all sectors with a 13.2% increase, driven by companies like Amazon.com Inc. and Tesla Inc., while Palantir Technologies Inc. was the top performer and Celanese Corp. the worst.

title: CDW strengthens cloud offerings through Mission Cloud acquisition
summary: CDW Corp. has acquired Mission Cloud Services Inc., a managed cloud service provider specializing in Amazon Web Services, for an undisclosed price. This acquisition aims to enhance CDW's cloud services, particularly their AI solutions and security offerings, and support their three-part growth strategy. Mission Cloud, with over 300 professionals and 500 customers, brings expertise in cloud management, migrations, DevOps, data analytics, machine learning, and generative AI to CDW.

title: Lotus Chooses AWS as Its Preferred Cloud Provider to Advance Connected and Automated Vehicles
summary: Lotus Technology has selected Amazon Web Services (AWS) as its preferred cloud provider to bolster its development of intelligent, luxury car experiences, aligning with its Vision80 Strategy to become a global luxury technology brand by 2028. Lotus will leverage AWS technologies, including IoT, analytics, machine learning, and generative AI, to enhance connected features like autonomous driving, immersive infotainment, and rapid vehicle charging. This collaboration aims to accelerate global growth by improving automated driving capabilities, customer service, and overall driver satisfaction.

title: Marvell Expands Strategic Collaboration with AWS to Enable Accelerated Infrastructure for AI in the Cloud
summary: Marvell Technology, Inc. announced an expanded strategic collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) through a five-year, multi-generational agreement. This partnership focuses on accelerating infrastructure for AI in the cloud by supplying Marvell's data center semiconductors and leveraging AWS's cloud infrastructure for Marvell's silicon design acceleration. The collaboration aims to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and speed up time-to-market for both companies.

title: News | Oracle's shrinking Boston-area hub triggers spike in available office space
summary: Oracle is significantly downsizing its Boston-area presence by listing over 400,000 square feet of office space across its Burlington campus. This move is part of a broader trend of tech companies like Google and Amazon reducing their real estate footprints globally, contributing to a record amount of available office space and increased national office vacancy rates. Oracle plans to consolidate its operations in one remaining building at 8 Van de Graaff Drive.

title: News | WeWork, Amazon partner on one of Manhattan’s largest office leases this year
summary: WeWork has secured one of Manhattan's largest office leases of the year, partnering with Amazon to provide over 300,000 square feet of space at 330 W. 34th St. This deal comes as major employers, including Amazon, are enforcing stricter in-office mandates, contributing to an improvement in Manhattan's office market, particularly for high-quality properties and flexible workspaces. The lease is among the largest in Manhattan this year and reflects a growing trend of tech tenants returning to the office, along with increased demand for flexible work solutions.

title: Amazon to pilot AI-designed material for carbon removal
summary: Amazon plans to pilot a new carbon-removal material designed by AI from the startup Orbital Materials for its data centers, which are significant contributors to emissions due to their energy needs. This initiative aims to mitigate the environmental impact of AI development and data center operations, posing a potential cost-saving alternative to traditional carbon offsets. The pilot, part of a three-year partnership, will start in 2025 at one data center, with Orbital Materials also using AWS technology.

title: 25 Best Stocks to Own in December, Including Broadcom
summary: Broadcom Inc. (NASDAQ: AVGO) is highlighted as one of the 25 best stocks to own in December, based on its historical performance of finishing the month higher eight out of the past ten years with an average gain of 7.3%. Despite a 4.5% loss in November, the stock is showing signs of rebound, is in "oversold" territory according to its 14-day RSI, and maintains long-term support. The equity is up 50.1% year-to-date.

title: Tesla leads November's global market value surge
summary: Tesla's market capitalization surged 38.1% in November, reaching $1.1 trillion, primarily due to expectations that CEO Elon Musk's relationship with President-elect Donald Trump will lead to relaxed regulations on self-driving cars. Other companies like Walmart and JPMorgan also saw significant market value increases, driven by strong earnings reports and investor confidence in future policies. Conversely, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company experienced a decline in market cap due to U.S. restrictions on chip sales to China.

title: After Earnings, Is Target Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar assessed Target's stock after its Q3 earnings miss and revised forecast. Despite a share plunge, Morningstar believes Target's stock is currently fairly valued at $135 per share, aligning with its 3-star rating, and notes the company lacks an economic moat due to intense retail competition. The article also discusses Target's strong financial position but highlights significant risks from digital retail competition, particularly from Walmart and Amazon.

title: JBG SMITH Launches Leasing At The Zoe in National Landing
summary: JBG SMITH has launched leasing at The Zoe, a new luxury apartment building in National Landing, featuring 420 residences and 10,000 square feet of retail. The 19-story tower offers diverse home types, extensive amenities, and is targeting LEED Gold certification. The Zoe contributes to JBG SMITH's ongoing placemaking efforts to create a vibrant, walkable, mixed-use community in National Landing.

title: Domino's® and Netflix Partner to Bring Emergency Pizza to the Squid Game Universe
summary: Domino's Pizza Inc. and Netflix Inc. have partnered to bring "Emergency Pizza" to the *Squid Game* universe, coinciding with the second season debut of the hit Netflix series. As part of this collaboration, players with the lowest scores at *Squid Game: The Experience* in New York City on December 12 will win free Domino's Emergency Pizza for a year. The partnership also includes custom *Squid Game* TV spots showcasing Emergency Pizza deliveries in nerve-wracking moments from the show.

title: Why Momentum Stocks & ETFs Are Crushing the Market
summary: Momentum stocks and ETFs are significantly outperforming the broader market this year, with factor investing in momentum demonstrating strong returns over the past decade. The Invesco S&P 500 Momentum ETF (SPMO) and iShares MSCI USA Momentum Factor ETF (MTUM) have seen substantial gains due to the continued investor interest in high-performing stocks. Companies like Amazon, NVIDIA, Meta Platforms, Berkshire Hathaway, and Eli Lilly are key holdings driving the performance of these momentum-focused ETFs.

title: Attorney General Schwalb Sues Amazon for Secretly Excluding Ward 7 & 8 ZIP Codes from Prime Membership Delivery Benefits
summary: Attorney General Brian L. Schwalb has sued Amazon for allegedly deceiving District residents in Ward 7 and 8 by charging full Prime membership prices while secretly excluding their ZIP codes from the advertised fastest delivery services since 2022. The lawsuit claims that approximately 48,000 Prime members in ZIP codes 20019 and 20020 experienced significantly slower delivery times after Amazon stopped using its branded trucks in these areas, without informing customers. The Office of the Attorney General seeks to stop these deceptive practices, obtain restitution and damages for affected members, and collect civil penalties.

title: SRM Entertainment's Amazon Sales Surge Over 400% in Three Months, Fueling Strong Financial Performance
summary: SRM Entertainment announced that its Amazon sales have surged over 417% in three months, driven by strong customer demand for high-margin products. The company credits Amazon's tools and expertise for this growth and anticipates continued strong performance into 2025 and 2026 with new product launches. This strategic expansion into online and direct-to-consumer channels aims to diversify revenue, enhance profitability, and complement its theme park business.

title: Roku will be bought for a large premium in the next year, says Needham analyst Laura Martin
summary: Needham analyst Laura Martin predicts Roku will be acquired for a significant premium within the next year, citing its installed base, unique data, pricing power, and strategic importance as the only scalable CTV platform available for purchase. She believes Republicans taking control of regulatory agencies could facilitate such a deal in 2025. Martin maintains a buy rating and a $100 price target on Roku, highlighting its undervalued data assets and strong negotiating leverage.

title: Tech stocks hit first all-time high since July
summary: Technology stocks reached new all-time highs on Wednesday, driven by strong performances from key software players like Salesforce, Adobe, and ServiceNow, as well as megacap companies such as Apple, Nvidia, and Amazon. The Nasdaq Composite rallied 1%, and the Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLK) advanced 1.8%, marking its first new high since July. Marvell Technology also saw significant gains, surging 23% after a strong quarter.

title: SailPoint Now Runs on AWS Through the AWS Asia Pacific - Mumbai Region to Support Demand for Identity Security in India
summary: SailPoint has expanded its global presence by launching its services on Amazon Web Services (AWS) using the AWS Asia Pacific (Mumbai) Region, making it their ninth point of presence worldwide. This move aims to meet the growing demand for identity security cloud services in India, helping customers address data residency and privacy concerns. The expansion provides a highly available multi-tenant SaaS environment, ensuring data isolation and lower latency for local and regional customers, while also supporting compliance with local and regulatory standards.

title: Affirm Stock 2025 Prediction: Is AFRM a Buy or Sell After Its Recent Rally?
summary: Affirm (AFRM) has seen significant stock gains, outperforming the S&P 500, driven by key partnerships with companies like Amazon, Walmart, and Apple, and international expansion into the UK. The company is experiencing strong revenue growth and anticipates achieving GAAP profitability in fiscal Q4 2025. Despite increasing analyst bullishness, the author suggests that the stock's current valuation of 6.9x forward price-to-sales is high, making the risk-reward balance unfavorable for new investments after its recent rally.

title: Asana Recognized as a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Collaborative Work Management (CWM), once again
summary: Asana, Inc. (NYSE: ASAN) has been recognized as a Leader in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Collaborative Work Management for the second consecutive year. The company was evaluated for its ‘Completeness of Vision’ and ‘Ability to Execute,’ with its Work Graph® data model and Asana AI Studio highlighted as key differentiators. title: Amazon.com Inc. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
summary: Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) stock rose 1.10% to $220.55 on Thursday, outperforming the broader market. This advance marked the fifth consecutive day of gains for Amazon, despite a generally down trading session where the S&P 500 Index and Dow Jones Industrial Average both experienced declines.

title: Target sets sales records with exclusive Taylor Swift holiday offers
summary: Target has achieved record-breaking sales with exclusive Taylor Swift holiday offers, including a book and an album. The "Taylor Swift/The Eras Tour" book sold nearly 1 million copies in its first week, becoming the highest-selling new release print book of 2024 and the fastest-selling new release book of the last four years. This success highlights Taylor Swift's significant influence on consumer shopping behavior, with Target's executive praising the partnership's impact on Black Friday and Cyber Week.

title: Amazon.com Inc: Sustainable Packaging Policies for Flexible Plastics
summary: Shareholders are requesting that Amazon.com Inc. issue a report detailing how it plans to address flexible plastic packaging in line with the Pew Report's findings to reduce plastic pollution. This request comes amid growing regulatory and consumer pressure for sustainable packaging, particularly given that flexible plastics are largely unrecyclable and contribute significantly to environmental risks and potential financial liabilities for corporations. The report should assess risks, evaluate actions for fully recyclable packaging, and explore collaborative opportunities for reusable alternatives.

title: Nvidia Could See Competition From Magnificent Seven Peer
summary: Nvidia, a leading AI chipmaker, could face significant competition from Amazon, another Magnificent Seven peer, which is developing its own AI chip called "Trainium." This new chip, expected in 2025, aims to challenge Nvidia's market dominance in AI model training. The article discusses how Amazon's entry could provide a viable alternative to Nvidia's offerings and its potential impact on the chip market.

title: What Nashville public companies are paying to protect their CEOs
summary: Following the fatal shooting of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, companies are reassessing executive security. An analysis of filings from Greater Nashville's public companies reveals that security disclosures for top executives are uncommon. Dollar General Corp., for example, reported $51,692 in security and travel expenditures for its CEO, Todd Vasos.

title: ULTA Stock: Ulta Beauty Upgrades Full-Year Guidance
summary: Ulta Beauty (NASDAQ: ULTA) saw its stock increase by 10% after revising its full-year sales and profit projections upwards, driven by strong Q3 results that surpassed analyst expectations. The company reported EPS of $5.14 and net sales of $2.53 billion, announcing updated guidance including net sales between $11.1 billion and $11.2 billion and EPS of $23.20 to $23.75. This performance highlights Ulta's resilience in the competitive beauty market and its commitment to expansion.

title: Walmart, Amazon holiday spending rise as Target, Best Buy stumble, data shows
summary: Walmart, Amazon, Shein, and Temu experienced record-breaking sales during Black Friday and Cyber Monday, indicating a strong holiday season performance. In contrast, Target and Best Buy struggled, with Best Buy seeing declines and Target experiencing only a modest increase despite exclusive merchandise. This sales data suggests a diverging performance among major retailers during the crucial holiday shopping period.

summary: Quantum Computing Inc. (QUBT) has emerged as a high-momentum stock in the quantum technology sector, with an 869.5% return year-to-date as of December 6, 2024. Despite being a small-cap, pre-revenue company, QUBT has received significant orders for its photonic chips and gained attention through Amazon's AWS Quantum Embark program. The company's future growth largely depends on the broader quantum computing industry's expansion and its ability to achieve consistent revenue from its Arizona foundry, expected to begin production in early 2025.

title: Mission success for Rocket Lab’s latest suborbital hypersonic launch
summary: Rocket Lab USA, Inc. (Nasdaq: RKLB) successfully executed a suborbital mission in November to test hypersonic technology for the Department of Defense (DoD) under the Multi-Service Advanced Capability Hypersonics Test Bed (MACH-TB) project. This mission utilized Rocket Lab's test platform, which is designed for hypersonic technology tests with increased payloads and included experimental hypersonic instrumentation manufactured and integrated by Rocket Lab. The company emphasizes the importance of leveraging commercial launch services for affordable and frequent testing to accelerate hypersonic development.

title: FreightTech supershow with RXO, Happyrobot, GenLogs | WHAT THE TRUCK?!?
summary: This FreightWaves article discusses an episode of "WHAT THE TRUCK?!?" featuring CEOs from RXO, GenLogs, and HappyRobot. RXO's CEO Drew Wilkerson talks about the acquisition of Coyote and M&A trends in trucking. Ryan Joyce of GenLogs, a former CIA operative, explains how his company is combating freight fraud. Amazon.com Inc: Disclose Scope 3 Emissions
summary: Shareholders are requesting Amazon.com Inc. to disclose all material Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions associated with its retail sales, arguing that the company currently only reports emissions for its private label products, which constitute a mere 1% of total sales. This limited disclosure is seen as misleading and insufficient for investors seeking transparent climate-related risk information. The resolution emphasizes that expanding disclosure would mitigate risk, increase legitimacy of climate targets, and prepare Amazon for growing mandatory reporting requirements.

title: Is Now The Time To Look At Buying Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN)?
summary: Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) shares have seen a significant price increase and are currently trading at yearly-high levels. The company's future outlook is optimistic, with earnings expected to increase by 90%, which is not yet fully reflected in the current share price.

title: Federal Judge Blocks $25 Billion Kroger-Albertsons Grocery Merger
summary: A federal judge in Oregon and a Washington State judge have both blocked Kroger's $24.6 billion acquisition of Albertsons, citing concerns over reduced competition. This ruling is a significant victory for the Federal Trade Commission, which argued the merger would harm consumers and workers. The companies still have the option to pursue the deal if it is deemed lawful in the F.T.C.'s administrative proceedings, despite these preliminary injunctions.

title: Franklin Resources Inc. Reduces Stake in ClearBridge Energy Mids
summary: Franklin Resources Inc. has significantly reduced its stake in ClearBridge Energy Midstream Opportunity Fund Inc. (EMO) by 55.24%, selling 40,610 shares at $47.6 per share. This move leaves Franklin Resources with 0.26% of its portfolio in EMO, signaling a strategic adjustment based on EMO's declining stock price and poor potential for future performance despite its focus on high cash distributions. The transaction highlights Franklin Resources' conservative investment philosophy and focus on optimizing its $353.59 billion equity portfolio.

title: Does Dividend Investing Still Work?
summary: Dividend investing has faced challenges in 2024 with paltry yields compared to bonds, and share buybacks overshadowing dividends. Despite recent underperformance, especially against tech stocks, dividend strategies remain popular, attracting significant investor assets. A potential "paradigm shift" involving higher interest rates and geopolitical uncertainty could renew focus on dividends as a fundamental component of investment returns, echoing historical trends where dividend payers have outperformed non-payers over the very long term.

title: Top 10 Video Games Companies in the Global Market [2024]
summary: The video games market is a rapidly expanding industry, projected to reach USD 307.19 billion by 2029. This growth is driven by increased smartphone adoption, internet usage, and technological innovations like 3D graphics and online gaming. The article highlights the top 10 companies, including Activision Blizzard, Nintendo, and Sony Interactive Entertainment, which are stimulating this market through game development, hardware innovation, and integration of AR/VR technologies.

title: PREORDER - Transformers x Sonic Blue Booster & Wingtail Target Exclusive
summary: This article announces the pre-order availability of the Transformers x Sonic the Hedgehog mash-up figures, Blue Booster and Wingtail, exclusive to Target. These 5-inch figures convert between robot and vehicle modes, inspired by Sonic and Tails respectively, and come with themed accessories. The collaboration brings together two popular franchises for collectors and fans.

title: Amazon to offer Intuit's QuickBooks to third-party sellers
summary: Amazon is partnering with Intuit to make QuickBooks the preferred financial management solution for its third-party sellers. This multi-year strategic partnership will integrate QuickBooks directly into Amazon Seller Central, providing sellers with tools for financial management, compliance, and access to capital through QuickBooks Capital. The collaboration aims to help Amazon sellers manage finances, track profitability, cash flow, and tax estimates, with capabilities rolling out in mid-2025 initially for U.S. sellers.

title: SOLO(TM) Micro Modular Reactor Takes Over Wall Street: At NYSE, SOLO Redefines the Future of Clean Energy with Existing, Validated, and Qualified 1MWe Nuclear Technology
summary: Terra Innovatum is set to commercially launch SOLO, the world's first micro-modular nuclear reactor, by 2028 after introducing it at NYSE. This 1 MWe reactor, designed for mass production and with advanced safety features, aims to provide a sustainable, reliable, and cost-effective solution for global energy demands. SOLO is designed to meet various energy needs, support sustainable development goals, and power future technologies like AI, with discussions for further financing and engagement with the USNRC underway.

title: Oracle reaps benefits of infrastructure investments as AI usage spikes
summary: Oracle reported significant cloud revenue growth, nearing $6 billion for the quarter, largely fueled by a 336% increase in GPU consumption due to rising AI demand. The company is making substantial infrastructure investments, including $4 billion in capital expenditures this quarter and plans to double its fiscal year spending, while also expanding its OCI footprint to 98 cloud regions and forming multicloud alliances. This growth positions cloud database revenues as a third key pillar alongside OCI and strategic SaaS.

title: Omnicom's Interpublic Group buy to make it India's second-largest ad firm
summary: Omnicom Group's acquisition of Interpublic Group (IPG) will make it the world's largest advertising company by revenue. In India, this merger is expected to create the second-largest ad firm with a 25.7% market share, behind GroupM. Industry experts anticipate potential job losses due to overlapping operations and believe the merger could lead to a duopoly in the Indian advertising landscape.

title: The $25 billion Kroger-Albertsons merger has been blocked — for now
summary: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the proposed $25 billion merger between Kroger and Albertsons due to concerns from the FTC and eight states about competition and potential price increases. The article discusses how a change in FTC leadership under a new presidential administration could alter the outlook for this merger, as well as the broader landscape of antitrust enforcement. An update notes that Albertsons terminated the merger agreement with Kroger on December 4, 2024, a day after it was blocked.

title: Kroger's $25-billion deal for grocery rival Albertsons blocked by US courts
summary: A U.S. judge blocked the $25-billion merger between Kroger and Albertsons, a significant win for the Federal Trade Commission which argued the deal would reduce competition and lead to higher prices. The ruling was also supported by a Washington state court judge and has implications for consumer prices and worker bargaining power, though Kroger and Albertsons expressed disappointment and are considering their options. The FTC did not, however, successfully prove that the deal would decrease competition for unionized grocery labor.

title: PLDT unit builds up AI-ready data centers
summary: ePLDT Inc., the data center arm of PLDT Group, is prioritizing AI-readiness for 2025, transforming its facilities to support high-performance computing for enterprise clients. Its 11th data center, VITRO Sta. Rosa, already meets the minimum 17-kilowatt power requirement for AI workloads and plans to increase capacity to 50 kW. This expansion aims to accommodate growing digitalization and hyperscaler demands, enabling AI use cases like fraud detection and cybersecurity.

title: Albertsons sues Kroger after judge rules against grocery merger
summary: Albertsons has formally terminated its proposed $25 billion merger with Kroger and is suing its competitor, alleging Kroger violated their contract regarding the deal's approval process. This legal action follows a judge blocking the planned tie-up and highlights a dispute over responsibility for legal fees and a potential $600 million termination fee. Kroger has called Albertsons' allegations "baseless and without merit."

title: Albertsons gives up on Kroger merger, sues grocery chain
summary: Albertsons is suing Kroger and abandoning their $24.6 billion merger after judges halted the deal, citing Kroger's alleged failure to secure regulatory approval. Albertsons claims Kroger did not exert "best efforts" to overcome antitrust objections, which Kroger denies, accusing Albertsons of breaching the merger agreement. The lawsuit follows preliminary and permanent injunctions issued in federal courts in Oregon and Washington.

title: GE Vernova to Power City-Sized Data Centers With Gas as AI Demand Soars
summary: GE Vernova Inc. has secured multiple contracts to supply natural gas turbines for new data centers that are projected to consume power equivalent to that of major cities. These 5-gigawatt data center campuses are being developed by large technology companies, with some expected to be operational as early as 2028. This move highlights the surging energy demands driven by artificial intelligence and the tech industry's reliance on gas-fired power generation to meet these needs, complicating their green initiatives.

title: After Earnings, Is Marvell Stock a Buy, a Sell, or Fairly Valued?
summary: Morningstar raised its fair value estimate for Marvell Technology to $90 per share after its Q3 earnings, driven by strong AI demand and better-than-expected forecasts. Despite optimistic growth projections, the stock is considered roughly 25% overvalued. The company holds a narrow economic moat due to intangible assets in networking chip design and is focused on deleveraging while investing in growth.

title: What’s ahead for Kroger & Albertsons after their failed merger
summary: Following the failed $24.6 billion merger between Kroger and Albertsons due to regulatory blocking, both companies are now seeking individual strategies to gain market share. Key areas of focus include investing in e-commerce and advertising platforms, expanding private label brands, and potentially pursuing smaller, non-overlapping mergers or acquisitions. The Federal Trade Commission and state attorneys general hailed the merger's failure as a victory for consumers, preventing higher grocery prices.

title: Conagra Brands Introduces Badges on Select Healthy Choice Products, Leading Consumers to GLP-1-Friendly Options
summary: Conagra Brands announced a new initiative to introduce "On Track" badges on 26 select Healthy Choice products starting in January 2025. These badges will highlight items that are high in protein, low calorie, and a good source of fiber, making them suitable for consumers using GLP-1 medications for diabetes and weight management, or those seeking a healthier lifestyle. Healthy Choice is the first major food brand to explicitly label products as "GLP-1 Friendly" to help consumers easily identify appropriate meal options.

title: Dividend Watch: Natwest Shares Soar in 2024, but it’s not the FTSE’s Top Stock
summary: NatWest Group's shares have surged by nearly 90% in 2024, making it one of the top-performing UK stocks, though not surpassing Rolls Royce. The bank's dividend yield currently stands at 4.26%, down from 7.7% at the end of 2023. The article also touches upon the recent change in leadership with Paul Thwaite taking over as CEO.

summary: Conagra Brands is launching a new "On Track" badge for 26 select Healthy Choice food items starting January 2025, indicating they are high in protein, low calorie, and a good source of fiber, making them "GLP-1 friendly." This initiative aims to support individuals using GLP-1 medications for diabetes and weight management by providing convenient, suitable meal options. The labeled products, including Healthy Choice Café Steamers and Simply Steamers, have been reviewed and approved by the USDA.

title: JBG SMITH Unveils Updated Plans for Potomac Yard
summary: JBG SMITH has submitted new development plans for Potomac Yard in Alexandria, Va., proposing over 750 new multifamily, townhome, and dedicated affordable units across four vacant parcels near the Metro station. The initiative aims to provide diverse housing options close to transit, including 550 multifamily residences, 100 affordable units, and 116 single-family townhomes. This development continues the long-term transformation of Potomac Yard, which is anchored by Virginia Tech’s Innovation Campus and lies near Amazon’s HQ2.

title: Netgear Orbi 970 Wi-Fi 7 mesh router review: Excellent performance with a price tag that’s tough to swallow
summary: The Netgear Orbi 970 Wi-Fi 7 mesh router delivers top-tier performance, rivaling the best in its class, but comes with an "exorbitant" price tag of over $2,000 for a three-pack. While it offers easy setup, excellent wireless speeds, and 2.5/10G ports, its high cost, limited network controls compared to competitors like Asus, and lack of USB ports detract from its overall value. summary: The Liberty All-Star Equity Fund (NYSE: USA) reported a strong November 2024 performance, achieving a 6.38% monthly return on NAV and a 20.39% year-to-date return. title: General Motors Scraps Cruise, Alphabet’s Waymo A Big Part Of The Reason Why (NYSE:GM)
summary: General Motors (GM) has decided to exit the global robotaxi business, scrapping its Cruise unit after investing approximately $10 billion since 2016. This move will save GM $1 billion annually, attributed in part to intense competition from companies like Waymo and Amazon, alongside operational challenges. GM is now focusing on restructuring its battery-electric vehicle business, improving China operations, and returning capital to shareholders, making it a "Hold" until these changes show results.

title: Will the iShares S&P 500 ETF (IVV) return another 36% in 2025?
summary: The article discusses the extraordinary 36.34% year-to-date return of the iShares S&P 500 ETF (IVV) in 2024, largely driven by the "magnificent seven" big tech stocks. It explores whether this strong performance is sustainable for 2025, referencing an expert's bullish outlook on US equities due to anticipated earnings growth, healthy economic projections, and falling inflation. The expert suggests that the high valuations of the big tech companies are justified by strong fundamentals.

title: Charted: Magnificent 7 Market Cap as a Share of the S&P 500
summary: This article examines the increasing share of the S&P 500's market capitalization held by the "Magnificent 7" stocks over the past decade. It highlights that these seven stocks have grown by nearly 800% in market cap, reaching almost 35% of the S&P 500 by mid-2024, raising concerns about potential over-exposure for investors.

title: Uncertain About 2025 EM Growth? Consider KEMQ
summary: The KraneShares Emerging Markets Consumer Technology Index ETF (KEMQ) is presented as a potential investment opportunity for 2025, especially given the diverse outlooks for emerging market growth. The fund focuses on consumer technologies within emerging markets, including countries like China, South Korea, Taiwan, and India, and could benefit from policy support and diversification. KEMQ is noted for its YTD performance and technical indicators, positioning it as a fund of interest for the coming year.

title: AI Stock Klaviyo Breaks Out To New Highs, Tops Latest Entry
summary: Klaviyo (KVYO), an artificial intelligence leader, has broken out to new highs, making it a top AI stock to consider. Its marketing platform utilizes advanced machine learning to help businesses leverage their data. The stock rallied 4% Tuesday morning.

title: AT&T Just Joined the RTO Rebellion. But Are These Mandates a Good Idea?
summary: AT&T is mandating that its office employees return to working on-site five days a week starting in January, following a similar move by Amazon. This decision to roll back remote work could significantly impact workforce growth and employee sentiment, according to a new analysis. While RTO mandates are still relatively rare, research suggests companies offering flexible work arrangements experience greater workforce growth and job satisfaction compared to those enforcing a full return to the office.

title: Aurora opens Bozeman lidar facility as Volvo begins Texas truck tests
summary: Aurora, a Nasdaq-listed company specializing in lidar-based autonomous driving systems, has opened a new research and test facility in Bozeman, Montana, to support the development of its "FirstLight" technology. This expansion comes as Volvo Autonomous Solutions and DHL Supply Chain begin testing Aurora's self-driving truck system, "Aurora Driver," on public roads in Texas, with commercial operations anticipated to start next April. The system, which utilizes FMCW lidar, high-resolution cameras, and imaging radar, aims to revolutionize the transport industry by improving efficiency, safety, and addressing labor challenges.

title: Join the club: The economics of membership retail
summary: The article discusses the growing trend of membership retail, highlighting how warehouse clubs like BJ's and Costco have recently increased their membership fees and continue to see high renewal rates. It also explores the expansion of subscription models beyond traditional clubs, noting how giants like Amazon and Target are leveraging subscriptions for delivery and perks, and how niche lifestyle brands like Fabletics and Liquid I.V. are entering this space to cater to younger consumers' hobbies and interests. The piece emphasizes the benefits for both consumers, who receive convenience and extras, and companies, which gain recurring revenue and engaged customers.

title: Netgear to downsize HQ after leasing 89K sf building in San Jose
summary: Netgear is downsizing its headquarters by leasing an 89,400-square-foot office building in north San Jose, a significant reduction from its current 142,700-square-foot hub. This move into the building at 3553 North First Street is part of a growing trend of office transactions in Silicon Valley, which market insiders view as a potential rebound for the commercial real estate market following a period of high vacancy. The deal follows other major office leases and subleases by companies like Nvidia, Amazon, and Snowflake, suggesting renewed activity in the Bay Area's office sector.

title: 3 Top Schwab ETFs to Buy in 2025
summary: The article recommends three Schwab ETFs for long-term passive investors looking for a mix of income, growth, and value in 2025. These ETFs are highlighted for their low expense ratios and diversified exposure to different market segments. The selection includes Schwab U.S. Broad Market ETF (SCHB), Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD), and Schwab U.S. Large-Cap Growth ETF (SCHG).

title: Walmart Stock Soars 82% in 2024, Leading Retail Industry
summary: Walmart Inc. shares have surged 82% in 2024, adding approximately $340 billion to its market value and outperforming retail peers like Dollar Tree, Dollar General, Target, Amazon, and Costco. This growth is attributed to the discount giant thriving with high-income shoppers and innovation, with analysts anticipating continued market-share gains and increased profits from its higher-margin ancillary businesses in 2025. Despite a premium valuation, experts believe Walmart is well-positioned for further success due to its focus on household essentials, convenient delivery options, revamped stores, and growing advertising and membership income.

title: Freedom Holding Corp. Invests $650M in Kazakhstan’s Digital Future
summary: Freedom Holding Corp., through its subsidiary Freedom Telecom, is investing an estimated $650 million over five years to accelerate Kazakhstan's digital transformation. The company has laid 1,200 kilometers of fiber optic cable, is building core telecommunications infrastructure in 11 cities, and is developing public Wi-Fi networks and advanced cloud services in partnership with global tech leaders. Freedom Telecom aims to achieve 40% of Kazakhstan’s cloud services market share and become a Central Asian leader by 2027, while also launching a streaming service and exploring mobile network expansion.

title: NVYY Chart | GraniteShares YieldBOOST NVDA ETF
summary: This page provides a live chart for the GraniteShares YieldBOOST NVDA ETF (NVYY), listed on NASDAQ. It offers various chart types, technical indicators, and drawing tools for comprehensive analysis. The article also provides current trading data for NVYY, including its latest price, daily range, and 52-week range, alongside broader market data for major indices, commodities, and individual stocks.

title: Jabil’s Winning Streak Begins: Market Bottom Set, Future in Focus
summary: Jabil's fiscal Q1 2025 report indicates that the company has hit its market bottom, with a strong outlook for future growth despite a top-line contraction. The company outperformed expectations for both revenue and earnings, providing optimistic guidance and benefiting from strength in cloud, data center, and digital commerce segments. Analyst and institutional investor trends are positive, supporting a potential new all-time high for the stock.

title: Ulta Is Selling Toy Versions of Its Beauty Products. Is Marketing to Kids Ever OK?
summary: Ulta Beauty is drawing criticism for its viral Mini Brands collection, which features miniature replicas of beauty products packaged in mystery eggs. While popular, particularly on social media, some parents express concern that these toys, including items like "butt polish," inappropriately target young children for cosmetic consumerism. Ulta, however, notes the marketing success of the collection, with shares up and strong engagement, especially among Gen Z and Millennials, and increasingly, Gen Alpha.

title: Does the iShares S&P 500 ETF (IVV) pay passive income?
summary: The iShares S&P 500 ETF (IVV) can provide passive income through dividends, although its 12-month trailing dividend yield was close to 1% as of December 2024, which is lower than current term deposit rates. This low yield is due to its holdings being primarily growth-oriented technology companies with low dividend payout ratios and high valuations. While not ideal for income-focused investors, the IVV ETF has historically delivered strong capital growth, making it a robust wealth-builder.

title: Is Now a Good Time to Buy the Dip in Eli Lilly Stock?
summary: Eli Lilly's stock has faced a recent sell-off due to supply and demand challenges for its weight loss drugs, Mounjaro and Zepbound. Despite these near-term issues, the company is making significant investments in manufacturing and partnerships, and its clinical pipeline shows promise. This dip presents a potential buying opportunity for long-term investors, especially given recent positive news regarding competition and a share buyback program.

title: Apple looks to make a splash in 2025 with AI-infused smart home devices
summary: Apple is set to launch an AI-powered smart home hub in 2025 with a 6-inch display and new operating system, alongside upgrades to existing Home devices. The company is also developing an in-home security camera and a smart doorbell with advanced facial recognition, leveraging its commitment to privacy to gain consumer trust and expand revenue in the smart home market. These new offerings signal a significant push by Apple into the connected home ecosystem.

title: Reliance Global Group’s Roller Coaster Ride: Is It Time to Jump On or Off?
summary: Reliance Global Group Inc. (NASDAQ: RELI) saw its stock trend up by 216.67% on December 23, 2024, despite a challenging financial quarter marked by a nearly $837K loss and high operating costs. The company's complex financial picture includes a high debt-to-equity ratio, but also shows revenue growth over the past five years and ongoing strategic changes aimed at bolstering its core strengths and growth potential. Investors are assessing whether recent stock fluctuations present a lucrative entry point, while the company navigates opportunities and challenges to achieve profitability.

title: Nano Dimension Ltd. Appoints Julien Lederman as Interim CEO Following Termination of Yoav Stern
summary: Nano Dimension Ltd. has appointed Mr. Julien Lederman as Interim CEO, effective immediately, following the termination of Mr. Yoav Stern's role. The board of directors is conducting a comprehensive search for a permanent CEO while expressing confidence in Mr. Lederman's leadership during this transition. Mr. Lederman previously served as Vice President of Corporate Development and has a background with major firms like Amazon and Goldman Sachs.

title: Is Best Buy Stock Underperforming the S&P 500?
summary: Best Buy (BBY) stock has underperformed the S&P 500 over the past three months, six months, and year, despite its market dominance in consumer electronics. The company faces stiff competition, weak sales in key categories, and missed Q3 earnings and revenue forecasts, leading to a "Moderate Buy" consensus from analysts with a modest potential upside.

title: Gaxos.ai Inc. (GXAI) Launches Meshy 4 Update to Revolutionize 3D Modeling Workflows for Game Developers
summary: Gaxos.ai Inc. (GXAI) has released Meshy 4, an update to its Gaxos Labs platform, designed to enhance 3D modeling for game developers using AI-driven generative geometry. This update allows for dynamic mesh topology, polycount management, and improved geometry quality, aiming to accelerate asset creation. The generative AI market is projected to reach $1.3 trillion by 2032, driven by demand for AI products and infrastructure, with significant impact on various industries including gaming.

title: Costco defends DEI program as other major retailers drop controversial diversity push
summary: Costco's board of directors is urging shareholders to vote against a proposal to eliminate its Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) program, defending its practices as beneficial for employees, members, and suppliers. This comes as other major retailers have scaled back similar initiatives following a Supreme Court ruling and warnings from state attorneys general. The National Center for Public Policy Research is challenging Costco's DEI program, alleging it involves discriminatory practices and rebrands rather than eliminates problematic policies.

title: Growth ETFs Shaken Up as Tech Takes on Value Blush
summary: Growth ETFs like IVW are undergoing significant rebalancing as major tech companies such as Apple, Amazon, Microsoft, and Adobe are no longer considered pure growth stocks by S&P Global. This reclassification means investors will see a smaller allocation to these tech giants in growth ETFs and a larger presence of financial firms like Berkshire Hathaway and JPMorgan Chase, which are now being given a "growth blush". The rebalancing also shifts tech's share in the S&P Value Index significantly, with these companies now having their weightings divided between growth and value characteristics based on S&P's multifactor analysis.

title: Jim Cramer Says ‘Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) Is A Buy, And I Think It Will Continue To Perform Well’
summary: Jim Cramer has endorsed Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN) as a strong buy, citing its performance and strategic positioning in AI. The article highlights Amazon's role across the AI stack, its partnership with Anthropic, and discusses Cramer's investment tips for 2025 including avoiding "pigs get slaughtered" mentality, holding through tough markets, and staging buys.

title: How Vending Kiosks Curb Store Shrink and Optimize Labor
summary: Cantaloupe, Inc. has expanded its Smart Store vending machine line (600 and 700 models) for grocery stores, aiming to reduce shrink, optimize labor, and offer convenient shopping for shelf-stable and fresh items. These machines use weighted shelves and cameras for inventory monitoring and allow various payment methods. According to Cantaloupe's chief revenue officer, Jeff Dumbrell, the kiosks can nearly eliminate theft and improve customer experience by speeding up transactions, even for high-cost items typically prone to theft.

title: VerifyMe CEO Adam Stedham acquires $15,620 in common stock
summary: VerifyMe CEO and President Adam Stedham recently purchased 22,000 shares of the company's common stock for $15,620, increasing his direct holdings to 267,004 shares. This insider acquisition comes as VerifyMe proactively addresses potential Nasdaq delisting due to minimum bid price non-compliance while strategically shifting focus to profitable Authentication segments and aiming for adjusted EBITDA positivity by 2025. The company also reported a Q3 2024 revenue decrease and a net loss, influenced by a goodwill impairment, and has extended its share repurchase program.

title: Large-Cap Tech Stocks Could Soar Again in 2025
summary: Large-cap tech stocks, particularly the Magnificent Seven, are expected to continue their dominance and strong performance in 2025, according to market observers. Despite concerns over valuations and regulation, their focus on innovation and diversification positions them for another banner year. ETFs like Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) and Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF (QQQM) offer efficient exposure to these high-performing companies for growth-focused portfolios.

title: UiPath Stock is Consolidating: Is This the Right Time to Enter?
summary: UiPath (PATH) stock is currently in a consolidation phase, having declined 1.7% over the past six months despite a broader industry rally. The company, a leader in Robotic Process Automation, shows strong financial health with $1.6 billion in cash and no debt, and analysts have revised earnings estimates upward for fiscal 2025 and 2026. Given its undervalued status and growth potential, Zacks recommends PATH as a "Strong Buy."
